harnessContract.tree: headless Modal > header(title + breadcrumb/path editor) + Miller content(one listing column or selected parent + divider + child column) + footer(new folder + show hidden + cancel + open)
harnessContract.businessBoundary: listDirectory, createDirectory, onOpen and onClose are owner-injected capabilities; the browser neither owns Workspace adoption nor host filesystem access
harnessContract.liveness: superseding browse intent aborts its signal; close/reopen/dispose invalidate late listing and create settlements
